Defaults align upstream Butterfly 5.7.0: code_blocks.word_wrap false. Mapping: word_wrap→render.enable_code_word_wrap (if enable_code). True adds class word-wrap on .code-toolbar and wraps; false keeps horizontal scroll.

Non-blocking P2 from the independent review: upstream highlight.styl computes wordWrap = highlight_enable && !highlight_line_number && code_blocks.word_wrap (line numbers disable wrap at compile time); this PR does not implement that exclusion, so wrap may still apply when line numbers are on. No dual-site lab. CSS is a Prism runtime adaptation (pre-wrap + overflow-wrap) rather than the upstream compile-time mixin.
